# Drawlib Documentation

> Pure-Python library and multi-target compiler for Illustration as Code and Illustrated Documentation as Code — built for AI coding agents and developers.

## Overview

- [Welcome](https://www.drawlib.com/en/): Drawlib is a declarative drawing library and multi-format documentation compiler crafted for "Illustration as Code" and "Illustrated Documentation as Code".…

- [Quick Start Guide](https://www.drawlib.com/en/01_getting_started/quick_start.html): Drawlib makes creating publication-ready technical diagrams intuitive and reproducible—whether authored as standalone Python scripts (.py) or embedded…
- [Core Visual Concepts](https://www.drawlib.com/en/01_getting_started/core_concepts.html): To create clean, professional illustrations with Drawlib, it is important to understand its underlying Cartesian coordinate space, anchor alignments, and…
- [Project & Build Overview](https://www.drawlib.com/en/01_getting_started/project_quicklook.html): Drawlib is not only a drawing library—it is a complete documentation compiler that bridges executable Python illustrations and version-controlled technical…
- [AI-Driven Workflow & Agent Setup](https://www.drawlib.com/en/01_getting_started/agent_quicklook.html): Drawlib v0.3 is engineered from the ground up for autonomous AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot). Instead of requiring…

## 7. Auto-Layout Graphs

- [ArchitectureGraph](https://www.drawlib.com/en/07_graph/architecture_graph.html): ArchitectureGraph is a declarative two-level macro/micro coordinate solver purpose-built for cloud infrastructure, VPC topologies, and multi-zone…
- [LayerGraph](https://www.drawlib.com/en/07_graph/layer_graph.html): LayerGraph implements a Sugiyama-style layered Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) coordinate solver—combining DFS cycle breaking, longest-path topological rank…
- [TreeGraph](https://www.drawlib.com/en/07_graph/tree_graph.html): TreeGraph implements the Reingold-Tilford / Buchheim compact tree layout algorithm, computing balanced (cx, cy) node centers and branch waypoints so that…
- [RadialGraph](https://www.drawlib.com/en/07_graph/radial_graph.html): RadialGraph places a central hub node at the origin (ring=0) and arranges connected nodes on concentric orbital rings (ring=1, 2, ...). Angular sectors are…
- [GridGraph](https://www.drawlib.com/en/07_graph/grid_graph.html): GridGraph places nodes into a structured 2D (row, col) matrix and routes edges cleanly between cells. While adjacent horizontal or vertical neighbors connect…

## Locales

- [English (en)](https://www.drawlib.com/en/): Pure-Python library and multi-target compiler for Illustration as Code and Illustrated Documentation as Code — built for AI coding agents and developers.
- [日本語 (ja)](https://www.drawlib.com/ja/): AI コーディングエージェントと開発者のための「Illustration as Code」「Illustrated Documentation as Code」ピュア Python 描画ライブラリ＆ドキュメントコンパイラ。

## Companion Portals

- [Official Bilingual Python API & CLI Reference](https://www.drawlib.com/api/llms.txt): Complete bilingual (`en` / `ja`) catalog reference covering all public Drawlib Python modules, classes, functions, style tokens, and CLI subcommands (`https://www.drawlib.com/api/`).
- [Drawlib Quickstart Handbook](https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/llms.txt): 16-chapter bilingual (`en` / `ja`) engineering onboarding handbook with downloadable PDF and Word `.docx` editions (`https://www.drawlib.com/quickstart/`).
- [About Drawlib Showcase Slide Deck](https://www.drawlib.com/about-drawlib/llms.txt): 39-slide bilingual (`en` / `ja`) 16:9 presentation deck with downloadable PDF and PowerPoint `.pptx` editions (`https://www.drawlib.com/about-drawlib/`).
- [Internal Software Architecture Specification](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/llms.txt): Layered internal software architecture specification (`l1_core` through `l4_canvas`, domain engines, and multi-target builders) for Drawlib contributors and AI agents (`https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/`).
